decks.notes: The main concept of this Combo - Hammer Time deck is to quickly equip Colossus Hammer to creatures like Ornithopter or Inkmoth Nexus to deal massive damage and pressure the opponent. The deck utilizes Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to reduce the equip costs and enable multiple equipment attachments in a single turn. Additionally, cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga provide card advantage and tutor for important pieces. The deck also includes protection with cards like Giver of Runes and Solitude while also having some disruption with cards like Spell Pierce.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through various means such as countering spells, removing threats, and manipulating the battlefield. It utilizes a combination of powerful Planeswalkers, versatile removal spells, and efficient creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan and establish dominance. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds additional synergies and strengthens the deck's overall strategy. By maintaining control of the board and outpacing the opponent's threats, this deck aims to secure victory through attrition and resource management.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently utilize various spells and creatures to assemble the Underworld Breach combo. By casting spells like Expressive Iteration and Lava Dart, while utilizing creatures like Sprite Dragon and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to power up its spells and generate advantage. This allows the player to effectively utilize the Underworld Breach ability to cast spells from their graveyard multiple times, overwhelming the opponent and securing victory. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending for removal and disruption.

The deck revolves around utilizing Cascade spells to quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and disruption. By cascading into high-impact spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst, the deck can generate explosive board states and apply pressure early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Shardless Agent and Murktide Regent further increases the deck's consistency and ability to control the battlefield. With a focus on aggressive plays and efficient use of Cascade mechanics, the deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victories through overwhelming force.

The deck's main focus is on using Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Wrenn and Six early in the game. It aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Spell Pierce and Prismari Command while controlling the board with Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending. The creativity aspect comes from using Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Dwarven Mine to generate tokens and trigger Indomitable Creativity for explosive plays. Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional control, while cards like Xander's Lounge and Jetmir's Garden offer utility and versatility in different situations.

The deck focuses on using control elements to manipulate the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing powerful Elemental creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef, as well as versatile spells such as Teferi, Time Raveler and Fire / Ice, the deck aims to establish board presence and maintain control throughout the game. Additionally, the inclusion of Keruga, the Macrosage as a companion provides additional card advantage and consistency to further enhance the deck's control capabilities.

The main concept of this Aggro - Affinity deck is to quickly flood the board with cheap artifact creatures and use cards like Cranial Plating and Shadowspear to boost their power and toughness. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga are included to provide card advantage and additional resources. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a high number of threats that are difficult to deal with efficiently, while also utilizing cards like Aether Spellbomb and Welding Jar for protection and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing combo pieces and the companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring in Modern 1 vs 1 format. The main objective is to generate card advantage and mana with cards like Mishra's Bauble, Mox Amber, and Chromatic Star, while using Grinding Station to mill the opponent's library. The deck also includes multiple legendary creatures like Kethis, the Hidden Hand and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to synergize with the legendary lands and activate their abilities. It aims to establish a powerful combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat expensive creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield quickly. The deck also utilizes Leyline Binding and Persist to protect creatures and combo pieces, while also using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismari Command for control and utility. The deck aims to be creative in its approach to combo off and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells. There is also a land package with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency and mana fixing.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to create powerful combos that allow you to cheat out high-cost creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Leyline Binding helps control your opponent's resources while Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional utility. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multicolor requirements, with fetch lands and shock lands ensuring consistent mana fixing. The overall strategy is to be creative and unpredictable, using a mix of spells and creatures to overwhelm your opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is focused on control and resource management. The deck aims to control the game through cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding, while also utilizing Heartless Summoning and Brought Back to take advantage of death triggers and mana reduction. The deck also includes various land destruction elements with Avalanche Riders and Mulldrifter to disrupt the opponent's resources. Additionally, the deck incorporates a small token strategy with Nissa, Resurgent Animist and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. Overall, the deck combines control, resource management, and disruption to maintain dominance in the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Indomitable Creativity, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Transmogrify to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield quickly. By combining creativity with combo potential, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining its own aggressive game plan. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and hand disruption to control the board and protect its combo pieces. Overall, the deck focuses on creating unexpected and explosive plays to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to combine cycling creatures like Architects of Will and Street Wraith with cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to eventually cast Living End, which will bring all the cycled creatures back onto the battlefield, wiping out your opponent's board and giving you a huge advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Grief and Force of Negation help disrupt your opponent's strategy while setting up your own combo.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. By utilizing cards like Supreme Verdict and Solitude, the deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds an extra element of synergy within the deck. The mana base enables the deck to consistently play its spells and control the game throughout the match.

The deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence by casting cheap spells to cascade into more powerful ones, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays and card advantage. By utilizing cascade mechanics and powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game. Additionally, the deck includes versatile spells like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower to interact with the opponent's strategy, while also incorporating impactful cards like Murktide Regent and Seasoned Pyromancer for added threats and value.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and disruptive spells like Counterspell and Force of Negation, while also having access to removal like Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast and aggressive tempo. The mana base is designed to support the deck's game plan with a balance of dual lands and fetch lands for consistency and flexibility in casting spells.
